entries.title: Can temperature monitoring detect a fire?
entries.description: Temperature thresholds can flag unusual conditions for investigation. They do not replace approved fire detection or emergency procedures.

content.heading: A few things to plan for.

entries.title: Can one sensor measure every silo material?
entries.description: No. The appropriate instrument depends on material properties, dust, surface shape and vessel geometry. A liquid-level sensor should not be assumed suitable for all bulk solids.

entries.title: Can readings be converted to volume?
entries.description: Volume estimates require vessel dimensions and an appropriate conversion model. Calibration and usable measurement range should be verified on site.

entries.title: Which brochure devices cover liquid storage?
entries.description: The range includes NT410-RDR radar, NT400-UDL ultrasonic and NU03 external liquid-level systems. Each has distinct mounting and compatibility requirements.

entries.title: Can multiple sites share replenishment data?
entries.description: A multi-site view can organise readings and history by location, vessel and material for the authorised teams.
